rationale: CalDAV routes not in swagger; contract only covers /api/v1 REST.
Batch create/update endpoint described with BearerAuth; no rule on namespace or project-bound creation.
Watch described with global ApiKey; no statement that READ is limited to granted key range.
Path has no tenant parameter; global bearer/cookie auth only; no tenant-binding statement.
Contracts are for RCA/finops agents, not openchoreo-api exec or wirelogs.
Restore described with global BearerAuth and 401; no role requirement stated.
No /log WebSocket path in node swagger.
deleteSources documented, only 401 response; no security section or owner scoping.
Node patch documented with global BearerToken; no rule about nodes and ownerReferences.
Blob and upload paths documented; no security section or per-repository read rule.
Only nanodep, nanomdm and terraform teams specs present; no Android pubsub path.
Endpoint documented with installation_id as free input; no ownership or tenant binding of installation stated.
Proxy path documented with global basic/api_key; plugin ReqActions per datasource not mentioned.
Node replace documented with global BearerToken; admission webhook validation behaviour not in spec.
Copy endpoint documented; denied_patterns described only as list of denied patterns, no source-side rule.
Gogs API spec lacks the non-API /attachments route.
Put documented with global basic/api_key; no mention of protected:write permission.
